name: Path Builder
description: Records your editor playtest path and auto-places blocks and spikes around it.

style.name: Placement Style
style.description:
<cy>basic</c>: floor/ceiling blocks + a few spikes under each jump.
<cy>dense</c>: fill every safe spot with spikes and use tighter corridors.
<cy>blocks-only</c>: no spikes at all.
<cy>tight</c>: spikes only, placed off-grid right against your real hitbox (pixel-close). Use with low Spike Clearance.

mode-cube.name: Cube (and Robot)
mode-cube.description: Generate platforms and jump spikes for cube/robot parts.

mode-ship.name: Ship (and Swing)
mode-ship.description: Generate a corridor around ship/swing parts.

mode-wave.name: Wave
mode-wave.description: Generate a corridor around wave parts.

mode-ball.name: Ball (and Spider)
mode-ball.description: Generate floor/ceiling blocks and spikes for ball/spider parts.

mode-ufo.name: UFO
mode-ufo.description: Generate a corridor around UFO parts.

max-spikes.name: Spikes per Jump (basic)
max-spikes.description: Max spikes placed under one jump in basic style.

spike-clearance.name: Spike Clearance
spike-clearance.description: Extra safe distance (units, 30 = 1 block) between the player hitbox and spike hitboxes. For tight style, 1 is very tight; 0 touches the edge.

spike-spacing.name: Spike Spacing (tight)
spike-spacing.description: Horizontal distance between spikes in tight style (units, 30 = 1 block). Lower = more spikes.

ship-margin.name: Ship/UFO Corridor Margin
ship-margin.description: Free space (units) kept above and below the ship/UFO path.

wave-margin.name: Wave Corridor Margin
wave-margin.description: Free space (units) kept above and below the wave path.

block-id.name: Block Object ID
block-id.description: Object ID used for blocks (1 = default block).

spike-id.name: Spike Object ID
spike-id.description: Object ID used for spikes (8 = default spike).

select-generated.name: Select Generated Objects
select-generated.description: Select everything that was placed so you can move or delete it in one go.
